verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe live editing where script changes appear instantly while the app runs in the browser Editor (playcanvas-docs-13, playcanvas-docs-26), directly matching the fast edit-run loop story. However community reports note that a smooth local hot-reload workflow requires extra tooling/tinkering rather than being built-in out of the box (playcanvas-comm-8, playcanvas-comm-9), and there's no first-party benchmark or independent confirmation of reload speed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of reload latency, native (non-community-hack) local dev hot-reload support, and clarity on how script live-edit interacts with the newer ESM/local project workflows.
